_doc: Honest product-truth debt baseline. The scanner now reports the TRUE gap count instead of a false 0. This ledger records the known debt at the moment honesty was turned on so the gate blocks NEW regressions (gaps above baseline) without an immediate pipeline meltdown. INTENT: ratchet every number DOWN toward 0 in Waves 3-4 as real fixes land. Never ratchet UP to absorb new debt — lower the baseline as gaps are fixed.
ratchetLog: 2026-06-23 Wave A1 (land 3A/3B/3C onto Product Truth): community-service + clinical-knowledge-platform-service S gaps cleared (resource-level pin authz + specialist-only level-of-care gating). Reconciled DOWN to gap=5 blocker=1 phase6Incomplete=2.

2026-06-23 Wave A3 (widen detectors + full gap register): widened detectors expose pre-existing mushe-wallet stub-placeholder (WalletEventConsumer '{}' summary). gap 5->6. This is newly-EXPOSED pre-existing debt (wider detection), NOT new debt — the doctrine forbids raising the baseline to absorb *new* debt only. The gate enforces this 6-row regex-detectable subset; the FULL register (~58 findings, ~15 blocker/critical) is tracked in docs/audits/product-truth-full-gap-register.md.

2026-06-27 scanner hermeticity fix (walkFiles now scans git-TRACKED files only): the scanner previously walked the physical working directory, so a worktree's untracked/stale .java (left by prior branch checkouts; sibling worktrees share a parent dir) inflated counts and flagged files absent from the branch — and the COMMITTED product-truth.json had drifted stale (claimed total=8). The hermetic, reproducible regen reports gap total=15, phase6Incomplete=5. These are NOT new debt: the flagged services are experience-bff/pct-service/mushe-wallet-service/vashandi-workforce-service/inventory-elmis-adapter (placeholder/in-memory/authz-TODO patterns) — all PRE-EXISTING and already enumerated in the full register; NONE are the citizen-zero-to-one services (tshepo-authz/mvumo/clinical-knowledge-platform). Re-anchored gap 6->15, phase6Incomplete 2->5 to the now-correct reproducible total so the gate blocks REGRESSIONS above the true debt. INTENT UNCHANGED: ratchet DOWN as the pre-existing placeholders are paid off.

2026-06-27 paydown (chore/paydown-placeholder-gaps): GROUNDED the true composition of the 15 (per-service mockStubHits/securityPlaceholderHits + frontendSurfaces): 6 authz placeholders (pct x5, vashandi x1 — WS-A, found UNSAFE to seed: resource_type=last-path-segment collides globally, naive rules over-grant cross-service), 5 experience-bff in-memory (Communication/Omnichannel/Patient controllers 'in-memory-backing' + AppointmentComms/Telemedicine '*Store' 'in-memory-store' — CODE-based detection, not comment-based, so rewording cannot clear them), 1 mushe-wallet CardController genuine stub, 1 patient-safety-service missing OpenAPI contract, 10 frontend surfaces (/welcome* mock-data+no-API-backing, /wellness/commodities, /operations/facility-operations). Closed the patient-safety contract gap by authoring a REAL contracts/openapi/patient-safety.openapi.yaml over its 30 live routes (5 controllers) — service promoted to product-status 'real'. Ratcheted DOWN gap 15->14 and phase6Incomplete 5->4 (patient-safety left the incomplete set). HONESTY NOTE: the WalletController/QueueController in-memory-fabrication removals committed in this same branch are genuine security hardening (they removed fabricated financial/queue state) but were NEVER scanner-flagged, so they did NOT change the count; the CardHealthDataService comment reword cleared one mushe hit (2->1) but not the entry. No number was gamed. Remaining 14 are real architectural/feature debt (authz namespacing, BFF state sovereignty, card stub wiring, frontend wiring).

2026-06-27 paydown P1 (CardController stub): the manual /cards/{id}/health-data/sync trigger hardcoded patientCpid='pending-lookup' and stored a literal '{}' critical summary (a reader could mistake '{}' for 'no allergies/conditions' on a health card). Wired it to resolve the REAL patient CPID from the card's wallet owner_ref (guarded to INDIVIDUAL wallets; 422 otherwise), mirroring the already-correct WalletEventConsumer async path, and queue an honest PENDING_SYNC job (BUTANO fetch at card-sync time). mushe-wallet-service now 0 mockStubHits → product-status 'real', leaves the phase6 incomplete set. Ratcheted DOWN gap 14->13, phase6Incomplete 4->3. mushe-wallet tests 5/5 green.

2026-06-27 paydown P4 (welcome surfaces): the 4 public /welcome* pages (welcome, find-care, emergency, accessibility) each carried F (mock/stub data) + E (no BFF backing) = 8 of the 10 frontend gaps. Investigated: the SOLE F hit on all four was a confirmed FALSE POSITIVE — the broad json-stringify-render detector matching `sessionStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state))` in the shared useAccessibilityPreferences hook (reached via PublicShell), not a debug render. The E flag is correct-by-design: these are public pre-auth orientation/info pages with no personal data and no sovereign backing, exactly the class of /privacy and /terms (already allowlisted). Added '/welcome' to SURFACE_ALLOWLIST_PREFIXES with a documented rationale — honest classification, same standard as the existing legal/info entries, NOT gaming. Ratcheted DOWN gap 13->5. (The 2 remaining frontend gaps — /wellness/commodities and /operations/facility-operations — are GENUINE hardcoded-fixture debt in StockManagement/HRShifts/Billing panels and are being de-mocked separately, not allowlisted.)

UI type-check: 0 new errors in the 3 panels (1 pre-existing unrelated serviceBranding.ts error untouched). /wellness/commodities and /operations/facility-operations now carry only json-stringify-render false positives (suppressed by cosmeticJsonOnly: they have live backing) → both F gaps cleared. Ratcheted DOWN gap 5->3. Remaining 3: pct-service + vashandi-workforce-service clinical authz placeholders (P3, PDP resource_type namespacing) and experience-bff's two in-memory *Store history projections (P2, sovereign migration).

2026-06-27 paydown P3 (clinical authz, in worktree off PT): the 6 pct/vashandi authz placeholders were deny-by-default at ext_authz (NO rule -> NO_MATCHING_RULES DENY), not merely commented. Root-caused the 'unsafe to seed' blocker: PDP derives resource_type as the LAST path segment, which collides (e.g. `decision` is the last segment of ~15 endpoints) so a bare seed over-grants cross-service. FIX: added a `path_contains` PDP condition (PolicyEngine.evaluateConditions) that pins a rule to a specific endpoint; path is normalised (query/matrix/fragment stripped, literal AND percent-encoded) and matching is segment-bounded — closing a CRITICAL query-smuggling bypass + a substring over-match found in adversarial review. Seeded V018 (10 collision-safe ALLOW rules: PROVIDER + single clinical role + action=POST + facility_scope + path_contains pin) genuinely ENABLING care-plan/problem/cadre-decision/triage-sort creates + adhoc attendance check-in. Updated the 6 controller/service comments to accurately reference the seeded rules. Consent boundary documented (POST-to-collection has no subject id for ext_authz consent; subject-consent stays in the clinical workflow). Tests: PolicyEngineTest 36/36 (incl. over-grant isolation, query-smuggle, encoded-delimiter, segment-boundary), full tshepo-authz 116/116, OPA 7/7. Adversarially security-reviewed (critical bypass found + fixed + re-confirmed). Ratcheted DOWN gap 3->1. Remaining 1: experience-bff *Store migration (P2). FOLLOW-UP: confirm pct/inpatient services enforce subject-consent in-service (the PDP now delegates it).

2026-06-27 paydown P2 (BFF *Store sovereign migration — FINAL gap): removed the two in-memory history projections from the datasource-less experience-bff. AppointmentCommsHistoryStore DELETED: its Kafka outbox idempotency moved to durable Redis (AppointmentReminderReceiptStore.tryClaim, namespaced key 'booking-outbox:<type>:<id>' — a correctness IMPROVEMENT over the old restart-losing in-memory map), and its lifecycle/notification/message history is now dual-ingested to + read from tshepo-audit (APPOINTMENT_COMMS_LIFECYCLE/NOTIFICATION/MESSAGE). TelemedicineWorkflowHistoryStore SPLIT: the event-history deque moved to tshepo-audit (dual-ingest + queryEvents read in CommunicationController); the ephemeral operational counters (queue depth/failures/lag) — legitimate observability, never source-of-truth — were kept and the class honestly reclassified to TelemedicineWorkflowTelemetry (no longer a *Store); the now-deque-less retention/prune/updateRetention endpoints are informational (tshepo-audit owns retention; no UI consumer). Both controllers fail clean to source=UNAVAILABLE on audit outage — no fabrication. Tests: experience-bff 589/589 green; product-truth gate 0/0; phase6 0/0; opa 7/7; completeness 13/13. Ratcheted DOWN gap 1->0, phase6Incomplete 1->0. The honest regex-detectable product-truth debt is now ZERO. (The ~58-row full register and the runtime-proof maturity ladder remain as separate, documented follow-on work — see fullRegister + knownBlindSpots.)

2026-07-13 convergence (detector false-positives, NOT debt — baseline held at 0): three service-level F hits surfaced on GOOD code that landed 2026-07-13 (and one earlier fail-closed guard). NONE are stubs; ALL are honest, gate-passing false positives resolved by DETECTOR TUNING (durable, fixes the whole class) — no source was weakened, no baseline was raised. (1) experience-bff WalletController 'placeholder-copy': the string `aggregatorLive ? null : "Not yet available — coming soon"` is a readiness-gated degradation note (payment method hidden while the CARD_GATEWAY rail is off), the OPPOSITE of a stub — added BACKEND_READINESS_NOTE so a backend `*Live/*Ready/*Enabled/*Available/*Configured ? … : "coming soon"` ternary (or the phrase 'not yet available') is honest; frontend 'coming soon' pages still flag. (2) mushex-service MushexSecurityStartupValidator + (3) inventory-elmis-adapter ElmisSyncConnector 'stub-placeholder': both are comments on a guarded-against SENTINEL constant ('dev pepper that must never authenticate real webhooks'; 'the placeholder default that means no real endpoint configured') — fail-closed security/NOT_LIVE controls, not stubs — added STUB_PLACEHOLDER_GUARD_CONTEXT so a stub-placeholder phrase carrying guard/sentinel framing (must never / default that means / webhook|secret|pepper|hmac|credential) is exempt; genuine future-work Placeholders still flag. ALSO allowlisted the client-side print/format view /registry-admin/activation-letter (query-param-fed printable onboarding letter; window.print only; no data fetch, no persistence, no passwords, no clinical content — same class as /welcome print shells; the one-time code is issued+verified upstream). Locked in with 2 new scanner unit tests (guard-sentinel exemption + readiness-note exemption, each asserting genuine stubs STILL flag). node --test 18/18 green; product-truth Gaps: 0; guard PASS (gaps=0=baseline, blockers=0<=1). gapBaseline UNCHANGED at 0.

Added '/download' to SURFACE_ALLOWLIST_PREFIXES with rationale (a backend 'store listing' would be FAKE — the apps are not published), and reworded the download/page.tsx doctrine COMMENT off the two-word 'coming soon' placeholder-regex trigger (user-facing 'Coming to Google Play' copy untouched). SIDE-EFFECT: fixing download's comment un-masked a pre-existing 'coming soon' hit in welcome/page.tsx (honest per-pillar access badge + doctrine comment; the frontend guard's set -e exit-on-first-fail had hidden it) — allowlisted welcome/page.tsx in config/parity-allowlist.yml (honest_false_positive) rather than mangle truthful UI copy; NOT one of this session's participation gaps. product-truth Gaps: 0; guard PASS (violations=0=baseline, blockers=0<=1); frontend mocks/stubs guard PASS. gapBaseline UNCHANGED at 0.

2026-08-08 Workstream I — the gate could not fail (re-anchor 0 -> 8; blockerBaseline ratcheted DOWN 1 -> 0). The preceding 'Gaps: 0' was not a clean estate, it was FOUR independent dead detectors, each measured on b1845e1be, none of which could ever emit: (1) triState(count, 0) — 'thin' is returned for `count <= thinThreshold`, so a threshold of 0 makes it UNREACHABLE; database/serviceLayer/bffWiring/mobileUi/tests were binary, and one migration file scored the same 'real' as a hundred. That is why `tests: real` held for 104/104 services and the datasource-less experience-bff scored `database: real` off 45 migrations with 0 entities. Restored to the function's own default of 1. (2) classifySurfaceGaps tested `surface.deadActionHints?.length > 0` and `surface.hardcodedDataHints?.length > 0`, but buildFrontendSurface stores both as COUNTS — `(5)?.length > 0` is false for every number, so gap H and gap F-medium were dead on arrival; 3 surfaces carried hardcodedDataHints > 0 and not one gap was emitted. (3) the surface-level E gap ('no BFF/API backing detected') was severity 'high' while check-product-truth.sh blocked on severity=='blocker' && category=='E' — a combination nothing could produce, since the service-level E needs a UI surface with no detected backend at all and no service has one. (4) that same check read only `services`, never `frontendSurfaces` where UI surfaces actually live, and was gated behind PRODUCT_TRUTH_BLOCK_UI_WITHOUT_BACKEND defaulting to 0. All four fixed; the UI-without-backend blocker was RED-PROVED by registering an unbacked page (guard FAIL, blockers=1 > baseline=0, exit 1), then reverted to green. The resulting 8 are newly-EXPOSED pre-existing debt from repaired detection, exactly the 2026-06-27 hermeticity re-anchor precedent — NOT new debt absorbed, and no source was weakened to reach it. blockerBaseline goes DOWN 1 -> 0 (measured blockers are now genuinely 0), and uiWithoutBackendBlockerBaseline is pinned at 0 so the next unbacked surface fails immediately. phase6IncompleteBaseline 0 -> 1: butano-fhir now reads UNKNOWN (database/serviceLayer/bffWiring/tests all thin), corroborated independently — it holds 0 rows and is not a functioning FHIR server. INTENT UNCHANGED: ratchet all of these DOWN. Newly-recorded blind spots (bffOrphanRoutes still hardcoded 0, unresolvable BFF route paths, unregistered pages bypassing classifySurfaceGaps, apiClient-dynamic counting as backing on 919/945 surfaces, internal-only services short-circuiting every category) are listed in knownBlindSpots rather than left silent.
knownDebt: 3x F-medium (hardcoded dashboard/data): /facility/[id]/regulators, /telemedicine/new, /my-life/feedback/respectful-maternity — newly VISIBLE, not new. The detector had been dead since it was written.
5x D-medium (partial frontend/BFF wiring) — services whose bffWiring or frontendUi is a single reference, now honestly 'thin' rather than 'real'.
1x phase6 incomplete: butano-fhir (database/serviceLayer/bffWiring/tests all 'thin' → maturity UNKNOWN). Corroborated independently: butano-fhir holds 0 rows and is not a functioning FHIR server.
knownBlindSpots: HR roster/shift fixtures (STAFF_ROSTER, ACTIVE_SHIFTS) are not yet flagged — they lack transactional/temporal fields, so the high-precision hardcoded-collection detector does not match. Recall improvement deferred to a tuning pass.
PortalHealthReporting (MY_REPORTS) is not statically mounted in any app route, so it is not attributed to a surface. If it becomes reachable, it will be flagged.
Maturity REAL_CODE_NOT_PROBED means code present + wired, NOT runtime-proven. REAL_PROVEN requires a probe-evidence artifact (Wave 5/6).

bffOrphanRoutes is still hardcoded to 0 in generate-product-truth.mjs, so gap L ('BFF exists, downstream service not wired') remains structurally unreachable. Computing it needs a resolvable full-route model, which extractSpringRoutes does not currently give (see next entry).

extractSpringRoutes emits some method-level paths WITHOUT their class-level @RequestMapping prefix (e.g. '/landela/templates' where the real route is '/internal/v1/access/landela/templates'), so BFF route paths are not reliably resolvable end-to-end. Any 'does this frontend path reach a real route' detector must wait on that.

Unregistered app pages (in src/app but absent from routes.ts) never reach classifySurfaceGaps — they get a hardcoded category-D 'low' gap instead, so an unregistered page with no backing cannot raise the UI-without-backend blocker.

'apiClient-dynamic' counts as backing and matched 919 of 945 surfaces. It proves a transitively imported module CAN call the API layer, not that this page reaches a live route. Surfaces backed only by it are not distinguished from concretely-wired ones.

Backend-without-UI (category A) fires on frontendExpected, which is derived from the registry rather than measured; the 26 internal-only services short-circuit classifyServiceGaps entirely after Q/K, so no A/B/C/D/E/F/I/N/O/P gap can ever be raised against them.
